claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.Process_Booing (0x060050A3) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 90-byte body. It loads MatchMain.inst, returns immediately when MatchMain.isMatchEnd is nonzero, otherwise increments MatchMain.BooingCnt by raw one. It compares the updated BooingCnt with raw 4096 and returns unless they are equal. On equality it calls Audience.inst.PlayCheerVoice with raw arguments 9 and 0, subtracts raw 128 from the same BooingCnt field, calls Audience.inst.TensionDown(), and returns. FACT-0074 pins the direct scheduler call at Referee.UpdateReferee IL+0x0033.
